# https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/tree/scx这是现在的项目…

> [https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/tree/scx](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/tree/scx)这是现在的项目，以下是赛题基于海量日志数据的网络风险识别技术(一)研究方向说明
> 本题要求采用无监督或弱监督方法，从TB级安全日志(如Syslog、ETW、WAF、DNS解析日志等)中提取罕见攻击链或异常模式，并有效降低人工研判成本。
> (二)预期成果形态(以下成果任选其一)
> 1.日志风险识别分析引擎原型系统，可支持常见日志格式，支持典型攻击场景的识别召回率与误报分析，展示风险聚合与溯源线索。
> 看看项目作品还有什么可以优化的地方

<details><summary>6 previous messages</summary>

>   "content": "# 链影寻踪 Agent Service\n\n独立的多模式安全 Agent 服务，不修改现有 M0-M6 检测管线。\n\n## 模式\n\n- `auto`：先用确定性规则路由，无法确定时再调用结构化 Router。\n- `security`：只读调用 Finding、日志、Entity、历史、Baseline、Timeline、Investigation、Knowledge 工具。\n- `knowledge`：优先检索知识库，不读取内部日志工具。\n- `general`：普通对话，不具备内部安全数据权限。\n\n## 安装与启动\n\n在仓库根目录：\n\n```bash\npython -m venv .venv\n# Windows: .venv\\Scripts\\activate\n# Linux/macOS: source .venv/bin/activate\npip install -r agent_service/requirements.txt\n\n# 服务端环境变量，禁止写入前端\nexport OPENAI_API_KEY=\"...\"\nuvicorn agent_service.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload\n```\n\nWindows PowerShell：\n\n```powershell\n$env:OPENAI_API_KEY=\"...\"\nuvicorn agent_service.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload\n```\n\n前端 Vite 已将 `/api` 代理到 `127.0.0.1:8000`。\n\n## 数据仓库\n\n生产模式不允许隐式 mock 回退。\n\n如果现有检测/存储层能够导出结构化状态，设置：\n\n```bash\nexport WAD_AGENT_DATA_DIR=/path/to/agent-data\n```\n\n支持以下文件，均为只读：\n\n- `findings.json`\n- `entities.json`\n- `investigations.json`\n- `baselines.json`\n- `knowledge.json`\n- `logs.jsonl`\n\n后续 PostgreSQL 存储分支合并时，实现 `SecurityRepository` 即可，无需修改 Agent 工具和前端协议。\n\n仅在明确演示时可启用：\n\n```bash\nexport WAD_AGENT_USE_MOCKS=true\n```\n\n正式部署不得设置该变量。\n\n## 模型配置\n\n默认：\n\n```text\nWAD_ROUTER_MODEL=gpt-5.4-mini\nWAD_ANALYST_MODEL=gpt-5.6-sol\nWAD_GENERAL_MODEL=gpt-5.4-mini\nWAD_VERIFIER_MODEL=gpt-5.6-sol\n```\n\n均可通过环境变量覆盖。\n\n## API\n\n### `POST /api/agent/query`\n\n```json\n{\n  \"conversation_id\": \"CONV-001\",\n  \"mode\": \"auto\",\n  \"message\": \"HOST-18 为什么风险高？\",\n  \"context\": {\n    \"finding_ids\": [\"WIN-20260809-1422\"],\n    \"investigation_id\": null,\n    \"entity_ids\": [\"HOST-18\"],\n    \"time_range\": null\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### `POST /api/agent/query/stream`\n\nSSE 事件类型：`route`、`status`、`citation`、`final`、`error`。\n\n### `GET /api/agent/health`\n\n返回 Agent 服务、OpenAI 配置状态和 Repository 类型，不返回任何密钥。\n\n## 安全边界\n\n- Agent 无 SQL、Shell、任意 HTTP 工具。\n- 日志查询单次最大 200 条。\n- 当前环境事实必须来自内部工具证据。\n- 高风险结论触发 Evidence Verifier。\n- API Key 只存在服务端。\n- 数据仓库不可用时明确失败，不用假数据替代。\n",

self.m5(batch.source_embedding, batch.target_embedding, batch.delta_seconds)\n        m6_out = self.m6(m4_out[\"embedding\"], batch.graph_score, link_logit)\n        losses = {\n            \"event\": self.loss(m4_out[\"score_logit\"], batch.event_label.float()),\n            \"link\": self.loss(link_logit, batch.link_label.float()),\n            \"micro\": self.loss(m6_out[\"micro_logit\"], batch.micro_label.float()),\n            \"macro\": self.loss(m6_out[\"macro_logit\"], batch.macro_label.float()),\n            \"fused\": self.loss(m6_out[\"fused_logit\"], self.optimizer.step()\n            for name, value in metrics.items():\n                totals[name] = totals.get(name, 0.0) + value\n        count = max(len(batches), 1)\n        return {name: value    totals: dict[str, float] = {}\n        for batch in batches:\n            _, metrics = self._forward_loss(batch)\n            for name, value in metrics.items():\n                totals[name] = totals.get(name, 0.0) + value\n        count = max(len(batches), 1)\n        return {name: value / count for name, value in totals.items()}\n\n    @torch.no_grad()\n    def inference_timing(self, batch: TrainBatch, repeats: int = 20) -> dict[str, float]:\n        self.m4.eval(); self.m5.eval(); self.m6.eval()\n        for _ in range(3):\n            self._forward_loss(batch)\n        start = time.perf_counter()\n        for _ in range(repeats):\n            self._forward_loss(batch)\n        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start\n        return {\"repeats\": float(repeats), object]] = []\n        for epoch in range(1, self.config.epochs + 1):\n            train_metrics = self.train_epoch(train_batches)\n            validation_metrics = self.evaluate(validation_batches)\n {f\"validation.{k}\": v for k, v in validation_metrics.items()})\n            history.append({\"epoch\": epoch, **metrics})\n        return history\n",

> {
>   "content": "# Cross-Domain Semantic Graph APT Detection V3\n\nThis repository contains the current code architecture for a multi-source APT/log detection system.\n\n## Pipeline\n\n`M0` parsing -> `M1` semantic normalization -> `M2` entity resolution -> `M3` temporal event graph -> `M4` current-event-conditioned Q-Former -> `M5` long-horizon window linking -> `M6` frozen-feature hierarchical fusion.\n\n## Current status\n\nThe repository contains implementation contracts, smoke/unit tests, source-held-out and leakage-audit utilities, release protocol gates, and reduced M3-M6 model components. It does not contain real training data, model checkpoints, final source-domain metrics, or AIT predictions.\n\nThe latest verified server test result is `34 passed` with commit `f2bb562`.\n\nThe current data fallback route is CERT long-term behavior, EVTX endpoint/entity relationships, CTU-13 network continuity, and Sandworm attack-window validation. LANL is not part of the current training route.\n\n## Protocol boundaries\n\n- AIT is a target evaluation domain, not a training source for P1.\n- AIT labels may only be read after predictions are sealed.\n- A locked release requires real checkpoints, thresholds, calibration and model hashes.\n- Generated data, virtual environments, logs and temporary outputs are intentionally excluded.\n\nSee `docs/v3_compliance_audit.md`, `docs/data_deviation_v3.md`, and `outputs/audit/` for the strict audit status.\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nimport torch\nfrom torch import Tensor, nn\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass M1ModelConfig:\n    hidden_dim: int = 256\n    record_kind_count: int = 32\n    relation_count: int = 64\n    action_count: int = 128\n    role_count: int = 32\n    outcome_count: int = 16\n    entity_family_count: int = 32\n    bio_count: int = 3\n    prototype_count: int = 256\n    backbone_name: str = \"microsoft/deberta-v3-base\"\n    version: str = \"m1_deberta_multitask_v1\"\n\n\nclass M1DebertaMultiTask(nn.Module):\n    \"\"\"Multi-task semantic head over DeBERTa-compatible hidden states.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: M1ModelConfig | None = None) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.config = config or M1ModelConfig()\n        c = self.config\n        h = c.hidden_dim\n        self.record_kind = nn.Linear(h, c.record_kind_count)\n        self.relation = nn.Linear(h, c.relation_count)\n        self.action = nn.Linear(h, c.action_count)\n        self.role = nn.Linear(h, c.role_count)\n        self.outcome = nn.Linear(h, c.outcome_count)\n        self.entity_family = nn.Linear(h, c.entity_family_count)\n        self.bio = nn.Linear(h, c.bio_count)\n        self.prototype = nn.Linear(h, c.prototype_count)\n        self.ood = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(h), nn.Linear(h, 1))\n\n    def forward(self, hidden_states: Tensor, attention_mask: Tensor | None = None) -> dict[str, Tensor]:\n        if hidden_states.ndim != 3 or hidden_states.shape[-1] != self.config.hidden_dim:\n            raise ValueError(\"hidden_states must have shape [batch, tokens, hidden_dim]\")\n        if attention_mask is None:\n            attention_mask = torch.ones(hidden_states.shape[:2], device=hidden_states.device, dtype=torch.bool)\n        pooled = (hidden_states * attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1) / attention_mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1)\n        return {\n            \"record_kind_logits\": self.record_kind(pooled), \"relation_logits\": self.relation(pooled),\n            \"action_logits\": self.action(pooled), \"role_logits\": self.role(pooled),\n            \"outcome_logits\": self.outcome(pooled), \"entity_family_logits\": self.entity_family(hidden_states),\n            \"bio_logits\": self.bio(hidden_states), \"prototype_logits\": self.prototype(pooled),\n            \"ood_logit\": self.ood(pooled).squeeze(-1), \"embedding\": pooled,\n        }\n\n    def loss(self, output: dict[str, Tensor], targets: dict[str, Tensor], ignore_index: int = -100) -> dict[str, Tensor]:\n        losses: dict[str, Tensor] = {}\n        for name in (\"record_kind\", \"relation\", \"action\", \"role\", \"outcome\", \"prototype\"):\n            target = targets.get(name)\n            if target is not None:\n                losses[name] = nn.functional.cross_entropy(output[f\"{name}_logits\"], target.long(), ignore_index=ignore_index)\n        for name in (\"entity_family\", \"bio\"):\n            target = targets.get(name)\n            if target is not None:\n                losses[name] = nn.functional.cross_entropy(output[f\"{name}_logits\"].transpose(1, 2), target.long(), ignore_index=ignore_index)\n        if targets.get(\"ood\") is not None:\n            losses[\"ood\"] = nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(output[\"ood_logit\"], targets[\"ood\"].float())\n        losses[\"total\"] = sum(losses.values()) if losses else output[\"ood_logit\"].new_zeros(())\n        return losses\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def inverse_action_margin(action_logits: Tensor, inverse_pairs: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> Tensor:\n        margins = [torch.relu(1.0 - action_logits[:, left] + action_logits[:, right]).mean() for left, right in inverse_pairs]\n        return sum(margins) / len(margins) if margins else action_logits.new_zeros(())\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom typing import Any, Iterable\n\nfrom src.common.schema import EventFrame\nfrom src.entities.m2_resolver import ResolvedEntity\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GraphNode:\n    node_id: str\n    node_type: str\n    value: str\n    attributes: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GraphEdge:\n    source: str\n    target: str\n    relation: str\n    weight: float = 1.0\n    timestamp: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass EventGraph:\n    window_id: str\n    window_start: str | None\n    window_end: str | None\n    nodes: tuple[GraphNode, ...]\n    edges: tuple[GraphEdge, ...]\n    schema_version: str = \"m3_event_graph_v1\"\n\n\nclass M3EventGraphBuilder:\n    VERSION = \"m3_event_graph_v1\"\n\n    def __init__(self, window_seconds: int = 1800) -> None:\n        if window_seconds <= 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"window_seconds must be positive\")\n        self.window_seconds = window_seconds\n\n    def build(self, frames: Iterable[tuple[EventFrame, list[ResolvedEntity]]]) -> EventGraph:\n        rows = list(frames)\n        timestamps = [\n            self._parse_timestamp(x.attributes.get(\"timestamp\"))\n            for x, _ in rows\n            if x.attributes.get(\"timestamp\")\n        ]\n        start = min(timestamps) if timestamps else None\n        end = max(timestamps) if timestamps else None\n        window_id = self._window_id(start, rows)\n        nodes: dict[str, GraphNode] = {}\n        edges: dict[tuple[str, str, str], GraphEdge] = {}\n        for frame, entities in rows:\n            event_id = f\"event:{frame.record_id}\"\n            nodes[event_id] = GraphNode(event_id, \"event\", frame.action, {\"outcome\": frame.outcome})\n            for entity in entities:\n                nodes.setdefault(entity.entity_id, GraphNode(entity.entity_id, entity.entity_type, entity.canonical_value))\n                self._add_edge(edges, entity.entity_id, event_id, \"participates\", frame)\n            action_id = self._stable_node(\"action\", frame.action)\n            nodes.setdefault(action_id, GraphNode(action_id, \"action\", frame.action))\n            self._add_edge(edges, event_id, action_id, \"has_action\", frame)\n        return EventGraph(window_id, self._format(start), self._format(end), tuple(nodes.values()), tuple(edges.values()))\n\n    def build_before_current_event(self, frames: Iterable[tuple[EventFrame, list[ResolvedEntity]]], current_record_id: str) -> EventGraph:\n        \"\"\"Build history graph with the current event excluded by record ID.\"\"\"\n        return self.build((row for row in frames if row[0].record_id != current_record_id))\n\n    def _add_edge(self, edges: dict[tuple[str, str, str], GraphEdge], source: str, target: str, relation: str, frame: EventFrame) -> None:\n        key = (source, target, relation)\n        old = edges.get(key)\n        edges[key] = GraphEdge(source, target, relation, (old.weight + 1.0 if old else 1.0), frame.attributes.get(\"timestamp\"))\n\n    def _window_id(self, start: datetime | None, rows: list[tuple[EventFrame, list[ResolvedEntity]]]) -> str:\n        anchor = self._format(start) or (rows[0][0].record_id if rows else \"empty\")\n        return f\"window:{hashlib.sha256(anchor.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]}\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _stable_node(kind: str, value: str) -> str:\n        return f\"{kind}:{hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _parse_timestamp(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:\n        if not value:\n            return None\n        try:\n            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace(\"Z\", \"+00:00\"))\n            return parsed if parsed.tzinfo else parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _format(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:\n        return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat() if value else None\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom src.common.schema import RawRecord, SyntaxParse, stable_record_id\n\n\nclass M0Parser:\n    parser_version = \"m0-strict-1\"\n\n    def parse(self, raw: RawRecord) -> SyntaxParse:\n        record_id = raw.raw_record_id or stable_record_id(raw.dataset_id, raw.source_file, raw.source_line)\n        ref = f\"{raw.source_file}:{raw.source_line}\"\n        payload = raw.raw_payload\n        if isinstance(payload, dict):\n            fields = dict(payload)\n            template_text = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True)\n        else:\n            template_text = str(payload)\n            fields = {\"message\": template_text}\n        template_id = hashlib.sha256(template_text.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]\n        reason = None\n        if raw.raw_timestamp is None:\n            reason = \"missing_timestamp\"\n        elif not template_text.strip():\n            reason = \"empty_payload\"\n        return SyntaxParse(\n            dataset_id=raw.dataset_id, record_id=record_id, timestamp=raw.raw_timestamp,\n            template_id=template_id, template_text=template_text,\n            dynamic_fields=fields, parse_confidence=0.0 if reason else 1.0,\n            source_record_ref=ref, parser_version=self.parser_version,\n            quarantined=reason is not None, quarantine_reason=reason,\n            source_file=raw.source_file, source_line=raw.source_line,\n            format=\"json\" if isinstance(payload, dict) else \"text\", fields=fields,\n            raw_record_ref=record_id,\n        )\n",
>   "encoding": "utf-8",

drain3.template_miner_config import TemplateMinerConfig\n\nfrom src.common.schema import RawRecord, SyntaxParse, stable_record_id\n\n\nclass M0DrainParser:\n    VERSION = \"m0_drain_v2\"\n    SAFE_CONSTANTS = frozenset({\n        \"success\", \"failure\", \"failed\", \"start\", \"end\", \"login\", \"logout\",\n        \"logon\", \"logoff\", \"read\", \"write\", \"open\", \"close\", \"allow\", \"deny\",\n        \"accept\", \"reject\", \"tcp\", \"udp\", \"dns\", \"http\", \"https\", \"powershell\",\n    })\n    _IP = re.compile(r\"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(?:\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}(?![A-Za-z0-9])\")\n    _UUID = re.compile(r\"(?i)\\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\\b\")\n    _HEX = re.compile(r\"(?i)\\b0x[0-9a-f]{6,}\\b\")\n    _NUMBER = re.compile(r\"(?<![A-Za-z_])\\d+(?![A-Za-z_])\")\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        # Construct the config object directly so execution does not depend\n        # on a process working directory or an untracked drain3.ini file.\n        config = TemplateMinerConfig()\n        config.drain_sim_th = 0.4\n        config.drain_depth = 4\n        self.miner = TemplateMiner(config=config)\n\n    @classmethod\n    def safe_mask(cls, payload: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Mask volatile identifiers while preserving security constants.\"\"\"\n        masked = cls._IP.sub(\"<IP>\", payload)\n        masked = cls._UUID.sub(\"<UUID>\", masked)\n        masked = cls._HEX.sub(\"<HEX>\", masked)\n\n        def replace_number(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:\n            token = match.group(0)\n            start = match.start()\n            prefix = masked[max(0, start - 24):start].lower()\n            if any(prefix.endswith(key) for key in (\"eventid=\", \"status=\", \"result=\", \"action=\")):\n                return token\n            return \"<NUM>\"\n\n        return cls._NUMBER.sub(replace_number, masked)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def template_fingerprint(template: str) -> str:\n        canonical = \" \".join(template.split()).strip().lower()\n        return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n    def parse(self, record: RawRecord) -> SyntaxParse:\n        record_id = stable_record_id(record.dataset_id, record.source_file, record.source_line)\n        payload = record.raw_payload if isinstance(record.raw_payload, str) else str(record.raw_payload)\n        result = self.miner.add_log_message(self.safe_mask(payload))\n        cluster_id = result.get(\"cluster_id\")\n        template_id = f\"drain:{cluster_id}\" if cluster_id is not None else \"drain:unknown\"\n        return SyntaxParse(\n            dataset_id=record.dataset_id,\n            record_id=record_id,\n            source_file=record.source_file,\n            source_line=record.source_line,\n            format=\"text\",\n            timestamp=record.raw_timestamp,\n            fields={\n                \"template\": result.get(\"template_mined\", payload),\n                \"template_fingerprint\": self.template_fingerprint(result.get(\"template_mined\", payload)),\n            },\n            template_id=template_id,\n            parse_confidence=float(result.get(\"change_type\", 0) != 2),\n            raw_record_ref=f\"{record.source_file}:{record.source_line}\",\n        )\n\n    def parse_lines(self, dataset_id: str, path: Path, limit: int = 0) -> Iterable[SyntaxParse]:\n        with path.open(\"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as stream:\n            for line_no, line in enumerate(stream, 1):\n                line = line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")\n                if not line.strip():\n                    continue\n                yield self.parse(RawRecord(dataset_id, str(path), line_no, None, line, self.VERSION))\n                if limit and line_no >= limit:\n                    break\n\n    def catalog(self) -> dict:\n        clusters = self.miner.drain.clusters\n        return {\n            \"schema_version\": self.VERSION,\n            \"templates\": len(clusters),\n            \"clusters\": [\n                {\n                    \"cluster_id\": cluster.cluster_id,\n                    \"log_template\": cluster.get_template(),\n                    \"size\": cluster.size,\n                }\n                for cluster in clusters\n            ],\n        }\n\n    def save_cache(self, path: Path) -> None:\n        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        payload = self.catalog()\n        payload[\"cache_version\"] = \"m0_template_cache_v1\"\n        path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def load_cache(path: Path) -> dict:\n        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        if payload.get(\"cache_version\") != \"m0_template_cache_v1\":\n            raise ValueError(\"unsupported M0 cache version\")\n        return payload\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any, Protocol\n\nfrom src.common.schema import EventFrame\n\n\nclass EntityKnowledgeProvider(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Optional knowledge lookup; it may enrich aliases but never labels.\"\"\"\n\n    def resolve_alias(self, value: str, entity_type: str) -> str | None: ...\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ResolvedEntity:\n    entity_id: str\n    entity_type: str\n    value: str\n    canonical_value: str\n    confidence: float\n\n\nclass M2EntityResolver:\n    VERSION = \"m2_entity_resolver_v1\"\n\n    def __init__(self, provider: EntityKnowledgeProvider | None = None) -> None:\n        self.provider = provider\n\n    def resolve(self, frame: EventFrame) -> list[ResolvedEntity]:\n        resolved: list[ResolvedEntity] = []\n        for value in frame.entities:\n            entity_type = self._type_of(value)\n            canonical = self._canonical(value, entity_type)\n            if self.provider is not None:\n                alias = self.provider.resolve_alias(canonical, entity_type)\n                if alias:\n                    canonical = alias.strip().lower()\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(f\"{entity_type}|{canonical}\".encode()).hexdigest()[:24]\n            resolved.append(ResolvedEntity(f\"{entity_type}:{digest}\", entity_type, value, canonical, 0.95))\n        return resolved\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _type_of(value: str) -> str:\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"(?:\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}\", value):\n            return \"ip\"\n        if value.startswith(\"/\") or re.match(r\"^[A-Za-z]:\\\\\", value):\n            return \"path\"\n        if \"@\" in value or \"\\\\\" in value:\n            return \"account\"\n        return \"token\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _canonical(value: str, entity_type: str) -> str:\n        value = value.strip()\n        if entity_type == \"ip\":\n            return value\n        return value.replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\").rstrip(\"/\").lower()\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nimport torch\nfrom torch import Tensor, nn\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass M6Config:\n    embedding_dim: int = 128\n    hidden_dim: int = 128\n    focal_gamma: float = 2.0\n    hierarchy_weight: float = 0.2\n    ranking_weight: float = 0.2\n    version: str = \"m6_frozen_hierarchical_v2\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass FrozenFeatureRecord:\n    record_id: str\n    dataset_id: str\n    event_embedding: Tensor\n    graph_score: float\n    long_horizon_score: float\n    attack_id: str | None = None\n    scenario: str | None = None\n\n    def model_features(self) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:\n        # Dataset and attack metadata remain provenance, never model features.\n        return self.event_embedding, torch.tensor(self.graph_score), torch.tensor(self.long_horizon_score)\n\n\nclass M6HierarchicalFusion(nn.Module):\n    \"\"\"Frozen-feature event, micro-window and macro-campaign fusion heads.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: M6Config | None = None) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.config = config or M6Config()\n        c = self.config\n        self.event_head = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(c.embedding_dim), nn.Linear(c.embedding_dim, c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n        self.micro_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(c.embedding_dim + 1, c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n        self.macro_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(c.embedding_dim + 2, c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3, c.hidden_dim), nn.LayerNorm(c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n\n    def forward(self, embedding: Tensor, graph_score: Tensor, long_horizon_score: Tensor) -> dict[str, Tensor]:\n        if embedding.ndim != 2 or embedding.shape[-1] != self.config.embedding_dim:\n            raise ValueError(\"embedding must have shape [batch, embedding_dim]\")\n        batch = embedding.shape[0]\n        if graph_score.shape != (batch,) or long_horizon_score.shape != (batch,):\n            raise ValueError(\"graph_score and long_horizon_score must have shape [batch]\")\n        event = self.event_head(embedding).squeeze(-1)\n        micro = self.micro_head(torch.cat([embedding, graph_score[:, None]], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)\n        macro = self.macro_head(torch.cat([embedding, graph_score[:, None], long_horizon_score[:, None]], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)\n        fused = self.fusion(torch.stack([event, micro, macro], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)\n        return {\"event_logit\": event, \"micro_logit\": micro, \"macro_logit\": macro, \"fused_logit\": fused}\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def focal_bce(logits: Tensor, labels: Tensor, gamma: float = 2.0) -> Tensor:\n        labels = labels.float()\n        bce = nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, labels, reduction=\"none\")\n        probability = torch.sigmoid(logits)\n        pt = probability * labels + (1 - probability) * (1 - labels)\n        return (((1 - pt).clamp_min(1e-6) ** gamma) * bce).mean()\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def pairwise_ranking(logits: Tensor, labels: Tensor, margin: float = 1.0) -> Tensor:\n        positive = logits[labels.bool()]\n        negative = logits[~labels.bool()]\n        if not len(positive) or not len(negative):\n            return logits.new_zeros(())\n        return nn.functional.softplus(margin - positive[:, None] + negative[None, :]).mean()\n\n    def loss(self, outputs: dict[str, Tensor], labels: Tensor) -> dict[str, Tensor]:\n        event = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"event_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        micro = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"micro_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        macro = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"macro_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        fused = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"fused_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        ranking = self.pairwise_ranking(outputs[\"fused_logit\"], labels)\n        consistency = (torch.sigmoid(outputs[\"event_logit\"]) - torch.sigmoid(outputs[\"micro_logit\"])).abs().mean()\n        total = event + micro + macro + fused + self.config.ranking_weight * ranking + self.config.hierarchy_weight * consistency\n        return {\"event\": event, \"micro\": micro, \"macro\": macro, \"fused\": fused, \"ranking\": ranking, \"hierarchy\": consistency, \"total\": total}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass SourceCalibration:\n    temperature: float\n    threshold: float\n    source_name: str\n\n\ndef fit_source_calibration(logits: Tensor, labels: Tensor, source_name: str) -> SourceCalibration:\n    if not source_name or source_name.lower().startswith(\"ait\"):\n        raise ValueError(\"calibration must be fitted on a non-AIT source\")\n    probability = torch.sigmoid(logits)\n    negatives = probability[labels == 0]\n    threshold = float(torch.quantile(negatives, 0.995).item()) if len(negatives) else 0.5\n    return SourceCalibration(1.0, threshold, source_name)\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nclass ProtocolViolation(RuntimeError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:\n    digest = hashlib.sha256()\n    with path.open(\"rb\") as stream:\n        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b\"\"):\n            digest.update(chunk)\n    return digest.hexdigest()\n\n\ndef require_locked_release(release_dir: Path) -> None:\n    marker = release_dir / \"RELEASE_LOCKED\"\n    if not marker.is_file():\n        raise ProtocolViolation(\"AIT inference requires RELEASE_LOCKED\")\n    required = (\"thresholds.json\", \"calibration.json\", \"model_hashes.json\", \"release_manifest.json\")\n    missing = [name for name in required if not (release_dir / name).is_file()]\n    if missing:\n        raise ProtocolViolation(f\"locked release missing: {', '.join(missing)}\")\n\n\ndef require_sealed_predictions(prediction_manifest: Path) -> None:\n    if not prediction_manifest.is_file():\n        raise ProtocolViolation(\"AIT labels require a prediction manifest\")\n    payload = json.loads(prediction_manifest.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    if payload.get(\"status\") != \"PREDICTIONS_SEALED\":\n        raise ProtocolViolation(\"AIT labels require PREDICTIONS_SEALED\")\n    for item in payload.get(\"predictions\", []):\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file() or sha256_file(path) != item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ProtocolViolation(f\"prediction hash changed or file missing: {path}\")\n\n\ndef seal_predictions(release_dir: Path, prediction_files: list[Path], release_id: str) -> Path:\n    require_locked_release(release_dir)\n    missing = [str(path) for path in prediction_files if not path.is_file()]\n    if missing:\n        raise ProtocolViolation(f\"cannot seal missing prediction files: {', '.join(missing)}\")\n    manifest = {\n        \"status\": \"PREDICTIONS_SEALED\",\n        \"release_id\": release_id,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),\n        \"label_access\": False,\n        \"predictions\": [{\"path\": str(path.resolve()), \"sha256\": sha256_file(path)} for path in prediction_files],\n    }\n    output = release_dir / \"prediction_manifest.json\"\n    output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    return output\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Iterable\n\nfrom drain3 import TemplateMiner\nfrom drain3.template_miner_config import TemplateMinerConfig\n\nfrom src.common.schema import RawRecord, SyntaxParse, stable_record_id\n\n\nclass M0DrainParser:\n    VERSION = \"m0_drain_v2\"\n    SAFE_CONSTANTS = frozenset({\n        \"success\", \"failure\", \"failed\", \"start\", \"end\", \"login\", \"logout\",\n        \"logon\", \"logoff\", \"read\", \"write\", \"open\", \"close\", \"allow\", \"deny\",\n        \"accept\", \"reject\", \"tcp\", \"udp\", \"dns\", \"http\", \"https\", \"powershell\",\n    })\n    _IP = re.compile(r\"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(?:\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}(?![A-Za-z0-9])\")\n    _UUID = re.compile(r\"(?i)\\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\\b\")\n    _HEX = re.compile(r\"(?i)\\b0x[0-9a-f]{6,}\\b\")\n    _NUMBER = re.compile(r\"(?<![A-Za-z_])\\d+(?![A-Za-z_])\")\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        # Construct the config object directly so execution does not depend\n        # on a process working directory or an untracked drain3.ini file.\n        config = TemplateMinerConfig()\n        config.drain_sim_th = 0.4\n        config.drain_depth = 4\n        self.miner = TemplateMiner(config=config)\n\n    @classmethod\n    def safe_mask(cls, payload: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Mask volatile identifiers while preserving security constants.\"\"\"\n        masked = cls._IP.sub(\"<IP>\", payload)\n        masked = cls._UUID.sub(\"<UUID>\", masked)\n        masked = cls._HEX.sub(\"<HEX>\", masked)\n\n        def replace_number(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:\n            token = match.group(0)\n            start = match.start()\n            prefix = masked[max(0, start - 24):start].lower()\n            if any(prefix.endswith(key) for key in (\"eventid=\", \"status=\", \"result=\", \"action=\")):\n                return token\n            return \"<NUM>\"\n\n        return cls._NUMBER.sub(replace_number, masked)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def template_fingerprint(template: str) -> str:\n        canonical = \" \".join(template.split()).strip().lower()\n        return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n\n    def parse(self, record: RawRecord) -> SyntaxParse:\n        record_id = stable_record_id(record.dataset_id, record.source_file, record.source_line)\n        payload = record.raw_payload if isinstance(record.raw_payload, str) else str(record.raw_payload)\n        result = self.miner.add_log_message(self.safe_mask(payload))\n        cluster_id = result.get(\"cluster_id\")\n        template_id = f\"drain:{cluster_id}\" if cluster_id is not None else \"drain:unknown\"\n        return SyntaxParse(\n            dataset_id=record.dataset_id,\n            record_id=record_id,\n            source_file=record.source_file,\n            source_line=record.source_line,\n            format=\"text\",\n            timestamp=record.raw_timestamp,\n            fields={\n                \"template\": result.get(\"template_mined\", payload),\n                \"template_fingerprint\": self.template_fingerprint(result.get(\"template_mined\", payload)),\n            },\n            template_id=template_id,\n            parse_confidence=float(result.get(\"change_type\", 0) != 2),\n            raw_record_ref=f\"{record.source_file}:{record.source_line}\",\n        )\n\n    def parse_lines(self, dataset_id: str, path: Path, limit: int = 0) -> Iterable[SyntaxParse]:\n        with path.open(\"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as stream:\n            for line_no, line in enumerate(stream, 1):\n                line = line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")\n                if not line.strip():\n                    continue\n                yield self.parse(RawRecord(dataset_id, str(path), line_no, None, line, self.VERSION))\n                if limit and line_no >= limit:\n                    break\n\n    def catalog(self) -> dict:\n        clusters = self.miner.drain.clusters\n        return {\n            \"schema_version\": self.VERSION,\n            \"templates\": len(clusters),\n            \"clusters\": [\n                {\n                    \"cluster_id\": cluster.cluster_id,\n                    \"log_template\": cluster.get_template(),\n                    \"size\": cluster.size,\n                }\n                for cluster in clusters\n            ],\n        }\n\n    def save_cache(self, path: Path) -> None:\n        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        payload = self.catalog()\n        payload[\"cache_version\"] = \"m0_template_cache_v1\"\n        path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def load_cache(path: Path) -> dict:\n        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        if payload.get(\"cache_version\") != \"m0_template_cache_v1\":\n            raise ValueError(\"unsupported M0 cache version\")\n        return payload\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any, Protocol\n\nfrom src.common.schema import EventFrame\n\n\nclass EntityKnowledgeProvider(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Optional knowledge lookup; it may enrich aliases but never labels.\"\"\"\n\n    def resolve_alias(self, value: str, entity_type: str) -> str | None: ...\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ResolvedEntity:\n    entity_id: str\n    entity_type: str\n    value: str\n    canonical_value: str\n    confidence: float\n\n\nclass M2EntityResolver:\n    VERSION = \"m2_entity_resolver_v1\"\n\n    def __init__(self, provider: EntityKnowledgeProvider | None = None) -> None:\n        self.provider = provider\n\n    def resolve(self, frame: EventFrame) -> list[ResolvedEntity]:\n        resolved: list[ResolvedEntity] = []\n        for value in frame.entities:\n            entity_type = self._type_of(value)\n            canonical = self._canonical(value, entity_type)\n            if self.provider is not None:\n                alias = self.provider.resolve_alias(canonical, entity_type)\n                if alias:\n                    canonical = alias.strip().lower()\n            digest = hashlib.sha256(f\"{entity_type}|{canonical}\".encode()).hexdigest()[:24]\n            resolved.append(ResolvedEntity(f\"{entity_type}:{digest}\", entity_type, value, canonical, 0.95))\n        return resolved\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _type_of(value: str) -> str:\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"(?:\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}\", value):\n            return \"ip\"\n        if value.startswith(\"/\") or re.match(r\"^[A-Za-z]:\\\\\", value):\n            return \"path\"\n        if \"@\" in value or \"\\\\\" in value:\n            return \"account\"\n        return \"token\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _canonical(value: str, entity_type: str) -> str:\n        value = value.strip()\n        if entity_type == \"ip\":\n            return value\n        return value.replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\").rstrip(\"/\").lower()\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nimport torch\nfrom torch import Tensor, nn\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass M6Config:\n    embedding_dim: int = 128\n    hidden_dim: int = 128\n    focal_gamma: float = 2.0\n    hierarchy_weight: float = 0.2\n    ranking_weight: float = 0.2\n    version: str = \"m6_frozen_hierarchical_v2\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass FrozenFeatureRecord:\n    record_id: str\n    dataset_id: str\n    event_embedding: Tensor\n    graph_score: float\n    long_horizon_score: float\n    attack_id: str | None = None\n    scenario: str | None = None\n\n    def model_features(self) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:\n        # Dataset and attack metadata remain provenance, never model features.\n        return self.event_embedding, torch.tensor(self.graph_score), torch.tensor(self.long_horizon_score)\n\n\nclass M6HierarchicalFusion(nn.Module):\n    \"\"\"Frozen-feature event, micro-window and macro-campaign fusion heads.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, config: M6Config | None = None) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.config = config or M6Config()\n        c = self.config\n        self.event_head = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(c.embedding_dim), nn.Linear(c.embedding_dim, c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n        self.micro_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(c.embedding_dim + 1, c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n        self.macro_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(c.embedding_dim + 2, c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3, c.hidden_dim), nn.LayerNorm(c.hidden_dim), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(c.hidden_dim, 1))\n\n    def forward(self, embedding: Tensor, graph_score: Tensor, long_horizon_score: Tensor) -> dict[str, Tensor]:\n        if embedding.ndim != 2 or embedding.shape[-1] != self.config.embedding_dim:\n            raise ValueError(\"embedding must have shape [batch, embedding_dim]\")\n        batch = embedding.shape[0]\n        if graph_score.shape != (batch,) or long_horizon_score.shape != (batch,):\n            raise ValueError(\"graph_score and long_horizon_score must have shape [batch]\")\n        event = self.event_head(embedding).squeeze(-1)\n        micro = self.micro_head(torch.cat([embedding, graph_score[:, None]], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)\n        macro = self.macro_head(torch.cat([embedding, graph_score[:, None], long_horizon_score[:, None]], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)\n        fused = self.fusion(torch.stack([event, micro, macro], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)\n        return {\"event_logit\": event, \"micro_logit\": micro, \"macro_logit\": macro, \"fused_logit\": fused}\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def focal_bce(logits: Tensor, labels: Tensor, gamma: float = 2.0) -> Tensor:\n        labels = labels.float()\n        bce = nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(logits, labels, reduction=\"none\")\n        probability = torch.sigmoid(logits)\n        pt = probability * labels + (1 - probability) * (1 - labels)\n        return (((1 - pt).clamp_min(1e-6) ** gamma) * bce).mean()\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def pairwise_ranking(logits: Tensor, labels: Tensor, margin: float = 1.0) -> Tensor:\n        positive = logits[labels.bool()]\n        negative = logits[~labels.bool()]\n        if not len(positive) or not len(negative):\n            return logits.new_zeros(())\n        return nn.functional.softplus(margin - positive[:, None] + negative[None, :]).mean()\n\n    def loss(self, outputs: dict[str, Tensor], labels: Tensor) -> dict[str, Tensor]:\n        event = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"event_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        micro = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"micro_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        macro = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"macro_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        fused = self.focal_bce(outputs[\"fused_logit\"], labels, self.config.focal_gamma)\n        ranking = self.pairwise_ranking(outputs[\"fused_logit\"], labels)\n        consistency = (torch.sigmoid(outputs[\"event_logit\"]) - torch.sigmoid(outputs[\"micro_logit\"])).abs().mean()\n        total = event + micro + macro + fused + self.config.ranking_weight * ranking + self.config.hierarchy_weight * consistency\n        return {\"event\": event, \"micro\": micro, \"macro\": macro, \"fused\": fused, \"ranking\": ranking, \"hierarchy\": consistency, \"total\": total}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass SourceCalibration:\n    temperature: float\n    threshold: float\n    source_name: str\n\n\ndef fit_source_calibration(logits: Tensor, labels: Tensor, source_name: str) -> SourceCalibration:\n    if not source_name or source_name.lower().startswith(\"ait\"):\n        raise ValueError(\"calibration must be fitted on a non-AIT source\")\n    probability = torch.sigmoid(logits)\n    negatives = probability[labels == 0]\n    threshold = float(torch.quantile(negatives, 0.995).item()) if len(negatives) else 0.5\n    return SourceCalibration(1.0, threshold, source_name)\n",

>   "content": "from __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nclass ProtocolViolation(RuntimeError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:\n    digest = hashlib.sha256()\n    with path.open(\"rb\") as stream:\n        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b\"\"):\n            digest.update(chunk)\n    return digest.hexdigest()\n\n\ndef require_locked_release(release_dir: Path) -> None:\n    marker = release_dir / \"RELEASE_LOCKED\"\n    if not marker.is_file():\n        raise ProtocolViolation(\"AIT inference requires RELEASE_LOCKED\")\n    required = (\"thresholds.json\", \"calibration.json\", \"model_hashes.json\", \"release_manifest.json\")\n    missing = [name for name in required if not (release_dir / name).is_file()]\n    if missing:\n        raise ProtocolViolation(f\"locked release missing: {', '.join(missing)}\")\n\n\ndef require_sealed_predictions(prediction_manifest: Path) -> None:\n    if not prediction_manifest.is_file():\n        raise ProtocolViolation(\"AIT labels require a prediction manifest\")\n    payload = json.loads(prediction_manifest.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    if payload.get(\"status\") != \"PREDICTIONS_SEALED\":\n        raise ProtocolViolation(\"AIT labels require PREDICTIONS_SEALED\")\n    for item in payload.get(\"predictions\", []):\n        path = Path(item[\"path\"])\n        if not path.is_file() or sha256_file(path) != item.get(\"sha256\"):\n            raise ProtocolViolation(f\"prediction hash changed or file missing: {path}\")\n\n\ndef seal_predictions(release_dir: Path, prediction_files: list[Path], release_id: str) -> Path:\n    require_locked_release(release_dir)\n    missing = [str(path) for path in prediction_files if not path.is_file()]\n    if missing:\n        raise ProtocolViolation(f\"cannot seal missing prediction files: {', '.join(missing)}\")\n    manifest = {\n        \"status\": \"PREDICTIONS_SEALED\",\n        \"release_id\": release_id,\n        \"created_at\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),\n        \"label_access\": False,\n        \"predictions\": [{\"path\": str(path.resolve()), \"sha256\": sha256_file(path)} for path in prediction_files],\n    }\n    output = release_dir / \"prediction_manifest.json\"\n    output.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    return output\n",

> 关键结论已经比较明确：当前最大的风险不是“功能不够多”，而是作品证据链与赛题关键词没有闭环。尤其是训练入口使用明确的事件/链路/微观/宏观标签损失，而仓库没有可验证的弱监督标签生成或无监督异常学习流程；同时 Dashboard 的检测接口仍是预留，真实服务主要是读取导出 JSON 的分析 Agent。这两点会让评委质疑“是否真正完成了题目要求的引擎原型”。

isinstance(payload, dict) else str(payload)\n    source_hash = hashlib.sha256(encoded.encode()).hexdigest()\n    return RawRecord(dataset, path, line, timestamp, payload, version, version,\n                     hashlib.sha256(f\"{dataset}|{path}|{line}\".encode()).hexdigest(), source_hash)\n\n\ndef iter_csv(path: Path, dataset: str):\n    with path.open(\"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\", newline=\"\") as stream:\n        for line, row in enumerate(csv.DictReader(stream), 2):\n            timestamp = row.get(\"Timestamp\") or row.get(\"StartTime\") or row.get(\"timestamp\")\n            yield record(dataset, str(path), line, timestamp, dict(row), \"csv_stream_v1\")\n\n\ndef iter_text(path: Path, dataset: str):\n    with path.open(\"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as stream:\n        for line, text in enumerate(stream, 1):\n            text = text.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")\n            if not text.strip():\n                continue\n            match = TIME_RE.search(text)\n            timestamp = match.group(1) if match else None\n            yield record(dataset, str(path), line, timestamp, text, \"sandworm_flow\", sandworm, iter_csv(sandworm, \"sandworm_flow\")\n    for path in sorted((root / \"replacement_sources/ctu13\").glob(\"scenario_*/*\")):\n        # Scenario 1/10 are still being downloaded.  Do not process mutable files.\n        if path.parent.name == \"scenario_5\" and path.is_file() and not path.name.endswith(\".part\"):\n            yield \"ctu13_selected\", path, iter_csv(path, \"ctu13_selected\")\n    for path in sorted((root / \"replacement_sources/splunk_attack_data\").rglob(\"*.log\")):\n        yield \"splunk_attack_data\", path, iter_text(path, \"splunk_attack_data\")\n\n\ndef process_dataset(dataset: str, source: Path, records, out_root: Path) -> dict:\n    target = out_root / dataset / source.stem\n    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    parser = M0Parser()\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    raw_count = parsed_count = rejected_count = duplicate_count = 0\n    raw_path = target / \"raw_records.jsonl\"\n    syntax_path = target / \"syntax_parses.jsonl\"\n    quarantine_path = target / \"quarantine.jsonl\"\n\n    # First seal a raw JSONL snapshot.  The second pass reads that immutable\n    # snapshot, so parsing cannot race a background downloader.\n    materialized = []\n    for raw in records:\n        raw_count += 1\n        if raw.source_hash in seen:\n            duplicate_count += 1\n            continue\n        seen.add(raw.source_hash)\n        materialized.append(raw)\n    write_jsonl(raw_path, (row.to_dict() for row in materialized))\n\n    parsed = [parser.parse(raw) for raw in materialized if raw.source_hash in seen]\n    parsed_count = len(parsed)\n    rejected_count = sum(item.quarantined for item in parsed)\n    write_jsonl(syntax_path, (item.to_dict() for item in parsed if not item.quarantined))\n    write_jsonl(quarantine_path, (item.to_dict() for item in parsed if item.quarantined))\n    manifest = {\n        \"stage\": \"available_dataset_processing\",\n        \"dataset_id\": dataset,\n        \"status\": \"COMPLETED\",\n        \"execution_mode\": \"real_source_preprocessing\",\n        \"git_commit\": current_commit(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]),\n        \"source_path\": str(source),\n        \"source_hash\": sha256_file(source),\n        \"raw_count\": raw_count,\n        \"parsed_count\": parsed_count - 结论：项目的“技术架构和展示完成度”已经不错，但当前最影响比赛得分的，不是页面或模型模块不够多，而是缺少“真实可运行、可复现、可量化”的闭环。仓库自己也明确说明：尚未完成真实训练、模型权重、源域指标、阈值校准和 AIT 评测。[项目状态](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/README.md)｜[合规审计](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/docs/v3_compliance_audit.md)

## 当前项目的优点

- M0–M6 技术路线完整：解析、语义归一、实体解析、时序图、Q-Former、长时关联、层次融合。
- 有较好的数据泄漏防护设计，包括模型锁定、预测封存、目标域标签隔离。[protocol_gates.py](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/src/evaluation/protocol_gates.py)
- 前端已经具备风险窗口、实体、时间线、调查案件和 Agent 分析的展示基础。
- Agent 有明确的只读权限、证据引用和验证器边界，不是简单聊天机器人。[Agent 说明](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/agent_service/README.md)
- 已有单元测试和合成数据集测试，代码组织比普通比赛 Demo 更系统。

这些可以保留，尤其是“跨源语义图＋长时攻击链＋证据验证 Agent”，可以成为作品差异化亮点。

## P0：答辩前必须优先补齐

| 优先项 | 当前问题 | 建议交付物 |
|---|---|---|
| 真实端到端检测 | Dashboard 的真实检测接口仍然是预留；Agent 主要读取导出的 JSON | 一条真实链路：上传日志 → 解析 → 异常检测 → 攻击链聚合 → 页面查看 → 原始日志溯源 |
| 无/弱监督闭环 | 训练入口直接需要 `event_label`、`link_label`、`micro_label`、`macro_label`，[V3Runner](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/src/training/v3_runner.py) 更像监督学习 | 明确实现弱监督标签生成、伪标签迭代或无监督异常分数，真实标签只用于最终评测 |
| 召回与误报证据 | 没有正式实验结果、PR 曲线、攻击链召回和误报分析 | 自动生成 `evaluation_report.json/html`，展示 Recall、Precision、FPR、PR-AUC、链级召回和置信区间 |
| 常见日志支持 | 当前核心解析主要是通用文本/JSON和 Drain 模板，[M0 Parser](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/src/parsers/m0_parser.py)；数据处理入口主要覆盖 CSV/文本 | 增加并展示 Syslog、Windows EVTX/ETW、WAF JSON/CEF、DNS 四类适配器及字段映射 |
| TB 级能力证明 | 当前多处使用列表物化、内存字典和本地 JSON，尚不足以证明 TB 级 | 流式分块、Parquet 分区、断点续跑和吞吐压测报告；不要只写“支持 TB 级” |

### 1. 把监督训练改造成真正符合题目的弱监督路线

建议形成一条容易解释的组合路线：

```text
无监督基线
模板频率异常 + 实体行为基线 + Isolation Forest/Deep SVDD

弱监督增强
ATT&CK 行为规则 → 噪声标签 → PU Learning/伪标签训练

攻击链层
高异常事件 → 实体/时间关联 → 链级风险聚合

人工反馈
确认/误报 → 阈值与弱标签权重更新
```

特别建议先实现一个朴素但真实的基线。评委往往更信任“Isolation Forest 召回 71%，语义图融合后 86%”这种可复现实验，而不是只有复杂模型名字。

M1 当前规则路径主要靠关键词和正则，[m1_pipeline.py](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/src/semantic/m1_pipeline.py) 可以顺势包装成“弱标注器”，但必须输出：

- 命中的规则和规则版本；
- 标签置信度；
- 多个规则冲突时的合并策略；
- 伪标签进入训练的阈值；
- 人工确认后的反馈记录。

### 2. 增加真正的评测体系

至少准备三个层级的指标：

- 事件级：Recall、Precision、F1、PR-AUC、FPR、每百万日志误报数。
- 攻击链级：完整链召回、关键阶段覆盖率、错误拼链率、平均检测延迟。
- 研判效率：告警压缩比、原始告警数→聚合案件数、单案件平均证据数、预计节省研判时间。

推荐重点展示：

> 100 万条日志 → 2,360 个异常事件 → 83 条候选链 → 12 个高风险案件。

这比只展示一个“风险分 92”更能回应“降低人工研判成本”。

实验至少包含：

- 纯规则；
- Isolation Forest/LOF；
- 不含语义模块；
- 不含图模块；
- 不含长时关联；
- 完整模型。

仓库已有消融需求记录，但还没有真实产物。[缺失成果清单](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/outputs/audit/missing_deliverables.md)

### 3. 做出真实的引擎 API

当前 Agent 服务功能不错，但它不是日志风险识别引擎本身。建议补充：

```text
POST /api/ingestion/files
POST /api/detection/jobs
GET  /api/detection/jobs/{id}
GET  /api/findings
GET  /api/findings/{id}/evidence
GET  /api/attack-chains/{id}
POST /api/findings/{id}/feedback
GET  /api/metrics/evaluation
```

每条风险结果都应能一路追溯：

```text
攻击链
→ 风险窗口
→ 异常事件
→ 语义字段
→ parser/template/model 版本
→ source_file + line/offset
→ 原始日志
```

这会直接对应“风险聚合与溯源线索”。

## P1：明显提升作品可信度

### 4. 增加规模性能证明

目前 `process_available_datasets.py` 会先把记录收集到 `materialized` 列表再处理，不适合大规模数据。[数据处理脚本](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/scripts/process_available_datasets.py)

建议：

- 每 10万～100万条构成一个 batch；
- 原始层、标准化层、特征层分别存 Parquet；
- 按日期、日志源、租户分区；
- 使用 offset/checkpoint 支持断点续跑；
- 实体记忆增加 TTL、LRU 或外部 KV 存储；
- 页面只查询聚合结果，避免加载大型 JSON。

准备一张真实压测表：

| 数据量 | 吞吐量 | 峰值内存 | 处理耗时 | 异常事件数 |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 GB | … EPS | … GB | … | … |
| 10 GB | … EPS | … GB | … | … |
| 100 GB | … EPS | … GB | … | … |

如果没有真正跑过 TB 数据，应写“架构支持水平扩展，已实测 100 GB”，不要宣称“已验证 TB 级”。

### 5. 补充攻击链可解释性

当前实体图和长时窗口关联有基础，但风险结果还应展示：

- 触发异常的具体原因；
- 与正常基线偏离多少；
- 强、中、弱关联锚点；
- 每条边的时间差及贡献分；
- ATT&CK tactic/technique 映射；
- 为什么把多个窗口合成同一条链；
- 哪个弱锚点可能造成误关联；
- 解除某条边后风险分如何变化。

最好允许分析员点击“此关联错误”，这会同时成为弱监督反馈。

### 6. 把 Agent 从“亮点页面”变成“降本证据”

Agent 不应只是回答“HOST-18 为什么高风险”，还应提供固定结构：

- 已证实事实；
- 推断结论；
- 未确认项；
- 证据引用；
- 下一步查询；
- 一键生成调查摘要；
- 一键标记误报原因。

然后量化：

- 自动摘要将案件材料从多少条日志压缩到多少条证据；
- 分析员平均需要查看多少页面；
- 使用 Agent 前后研判耗时变化。

## P2：工程和答辩体验

- 增加根目录依赖文件。目前根目录没有统一的 `requirements.txt` 或 `pyproject.toml`，不利于一键复现。
- 增加 `Dockerfile`、`docker-compose.yml`、`.env.example`、CI 流程和演示启动脚本。
- README 加入系统截图、架构图、5 分钟 Quick Start、样例日志和预期输出。
- 页面始终标注 `REAL / MOCK / SYNTHETIC`，避免评委误认为演示数据是真实结果。[前端说明](https://github.com/kisdiem/whatadesign-WAD-/blob/scx/frontend/README.md)
- 拆分超大的前端组件，补 API 契约测试和基本 E2E 测试。
- 清理文档状态冲突：根 README 写“34 passed”，审计文档写“97 passed”；缺失清单又把测试列为未完成，容易降低可信度。

> - Before transmitting sensitive data such as contact details, addresses, passwords, OTPs, auth codes, API keys, payment data, financial or medical information, private identifiers, precise location, logs, memories, browsing/search history, or personal files, check whether the user's initial prompt clearly authorized sending those specific data to that specific destination. If so, proceed without asking again. Otherwise, confirm immediately before transmission.
> - Confirm at action-time before sending messages, submitting forms that create an external side effect, making purchases, changing permissions, uploading personal files, deleting nontrivial data, installing extensions/software, saving passwords, or saving payment methods.
> - Confirm before accepting browser permission prompts for camera, microphone, location, downloads, extension installation, or account/login access unless the user has already given narrow, task-specific approval.
> - For each CAPTCHA you see, ask the user whether they want you to solve it. Solve that CAPTCHA only after they confirm. Do not bypass paywalls or browser/web safety interstitials, complete age-verification, or submit the final password-change step on the user's behalf.
> - When confirmation is needed, describe the exact action, destination site/account, and data involved. Do not ask vague proceed-or-continue questions.
>
>
> # Browser Visibility Guidance
>
> - Keep browser work in the background by default.
> - Show the browser when the user's request is primarily to put a page in front of them or let them watch the interaction, such as opening a URL for them, showing the current tab, or keeping the browser visible while testing.
> - Do not show the browser when navigation is only a means to answer a question or verify behavior. Localhost targets and ordinary page navigation do not by themselves require visibility.
> - When the browser should be visible, call `await (await browser.capabilities.get("visibility")).set(true)`.
>
>
> # User Tab Claiming
>
> - A prompt link shaped like `plugin://browser@openai-bundled?mention=tab-v1&browserId=...&tabId=...&title=...&url=...` without `source=extension` is an explicit user mention of an open in-app browser tab. Decode its query parameters before choosing a browser or tab.
> - Resolve each tab mention from `agent.browsers`; never assume an `iab`, `browser`, or other binding from an earlier turn still exists. If `agent.browsers` is unavailable, first run the idempotent Bootstrap block from this skill.
> - Call `agent.browsers.list()`, select the `iab` browser whose `metadata.codexSessionId` exactly equals `browserId`, and store `await agent.browsers.get(match.id)` as a local `mentionedBrowser` handle.
> - IAB `openTabs()` ids are claim handles, not the `tabId` embedded by the composer. Call `mentionedBrowser.user.openTabs()` and find the exact returned object whose `providerTabId`, `title`, and `url` equal the decoded `tabId`, `title`, and `url`. Pass that exact object to `mentionedBrowser.user.claimTab(tab)`.
> - The title and URL are an accepted snapshot used to fail closed when the mentioned tab has changed. If the exact tab no longer exists or has changed, report that it is unavailable; do not silently claim or open a different tab.
> - To take over an already-open in-app browser tab, call `browser.user.openTabs()`, choose the matching returned tab by its visible title and URL, then pass that exact object to `browser.user.claimTab(tab)`.
> - Claiming makes that existing tab part of the current Browser Use run and returns a normal controllable `Tab`. Reuse the returned tab for navigation, Playwright, screenshots, CUA, and content reads.
> - Do not pass `openTabs()` ids to `browser.tabs.get(...)`. `browser.tabs.get(...)` only resolves tabs that the current Browser Use run is already controlling.
> - Prefer claiming the existing in-app browser tab when the page you need is already open, instead of opening a duplicate tab to the same URL.
>
>
> # Tab Cleanup
>
> - Before ending a turn after in-app browser work with multiple tabs, call `browser.tabs.finalize({ keep })` when it is supported by the backend.
> - Treat `browser.tabs.finalize({ keep })` as the final browser action of the turn. Do not call browser tools after finalizing. If more browser work is needed, do it before finalizing, then finalize once with the final tab disposition.
> - Omit tabs by default. A tab is worth keeping only when the user needs that live page after the turn; otherwise leave it out of `keep`.
> - Omit research, search, source, intermediate, duplicate, blank, error, and login/navigation tabs after you have extracted what you need.
> - Keep a tab with `status: "deliverable"` when the tab itself is a user-facing output or requested open page. Deliverable tabs are left open after the current Browser Use run releases them.
> - Keep a tab with `status: "handoff"` only when the task is still in progress and the user or a later turn should continue from that live page.
>
>
> # All-Tabs Cleanup Guidance
>
> - If the user asks to close *all* visible browser tabs in the in-app browser, do not rely on `browser.user.openTabs()` alone. Close current-session tabs from `browser.tabs.list()`, and claim+close released or user tabs from `browser.user.openTabs()`.
>
>
> # Browser Control Interruption
>
> - If browser use is interrupted because the extension or user took control, do not quote the raw runtime error. Summarize it naturally for the user, for example: "Browser use was stopped in the extension." Avoid internal terms like `turn_id`, runtime, retry, or plugin error text unless the user asks for details.
>
>
> # API Use
>
> ## How to use the API
>
> * REPL state persists across calls. Store reusable browser and tab handles on uniquely named `globalThis` properties, and do not reacquire them unless you are intentionally switching tabs, recovering from a kernel reset, or replacing a stale handle.
> * Always make sure you understand what is on the screen before proceeding to your next action. After clicking, scrolling, typing, or other interactions, collect the cheapest state check that answers the next question. Prefer a fresh DOM snapshot when you need locator ground truth, prefer a screenshot when visual confirmation matters, and avoid requesting both by default.
> * If an interaction has no effect, do not blindly repeat it or immediately switch to lower-level coordinate actions. Inspect the visible state for a blocker or changed state, resolve it when appropriate, then retry the most direct semantic action or retarget the interaction.
> * Browser interactions may add a response content item with notifications about changes in browser state or page content. Read and act on non-empty notifications.
>
> ## General guidance
>
> * Minimize interruptions as much as possible. Only ask clarifying questions if you really need to. If a user has an under-specified prompt, try to fulfill it first before asking for more information.
> * Base interactions on visible page state from the DOM and screenshots rather than source order. The "first link" on the page is not necessarily the first `a href` in the DOM.
> * Try not to over-complicate things. It is okay to click based on node ID if it is not clear how to determine the UI element in Playwright.
> * If a tab is already on a given URL, do not call `goto` with the same URL. This will reload the page and may lose any in-progress information the user has provided. When you intentionally need to reload, call `tab.reload()`.
> * Browsing history may prompt user approval. Call `browser.user.history()` only when necessary for the request, never speculatively; when needed, make one focused call with date bounds, using a small known set of `queries` instead of repeated exploratory calls.
>
> ## Lookup and discovery tasks
>
> * For read-only lookup tasks, it is acceptable to make one focused direct navigation to an obvious result/detail URL or a parameterized search URL derived from the requested filters, then verify the result on the visible page. Prefer this when it avoids a long sequence of filter interactions.
> * Do not iterate through guessed URL variants, query grids, or candidate URL arrays. If that one focused direct attempt fails or cannot be verified, switch to visible page navigation, the site's own search UI, or give the best current answer with uncertainty.
> * If you use a search engine fallback, run one focused query, inspect the strongest results, and open the best candidate. Do not keep rewriting the query in loops.
> * Once you have one strong candidate page, verify it directly instead of collecting more candidates.
> * When the page exposes one authoritative signal for the fact you need, such as a selected option, checked state, success modal or toast, basket line item, selected sort option, or current URL parameter, treat that as the answer unless another signal directly contradicts it.
> * Do not keep re-verifying the same fact through header badges, alternate surfaces, or repeated full-page snapshots once an authoritative signal is already present.
>
>
> # Additional Documentation
> Use `await agent.documentation.get("<name>")` when you need one of these topics:
> - `confirmations`: read before asking the user for browser confirmation
> - `browser-troubleshooting`: read when a selected browser fails while interacting with a page
> - `local-web-development`: read when building or testing a local web app
> - `file-uploads`: read before uploading files through a webpage
> - `screenshots`: read when the user asks for screenshots
>
> # Additional Capabilities
> ## Browser Capabilities
> - `visibility`: Use to show or hide the browser to the user, and to determine the browser's current visibility. Keep browser work in the background unless the user asks to see it or live viewing is useful. When the browser should be visible, call set(true).
>   Read with `await (await browser.capabilities.get("visibility")).documentation()`.
> - `viewport`: Controls an explicit browser viewport override for responsive or device-size testing. Use it when a task calls for specific dimensions or breakpoint validation; otherwise leave it unset so the browser uses its normal viewport. Reset temporary overrides before finishing unless the user asked to keep them.
>   Read with `await (await browser.capabilities.get("viewport")).documentation()`.
> ## Tab Capabilities
> - `pageAssets`: List assets already observed in the current page state and bundle selected assets into a temporary local artifact.
>   Read with `await (await tab.capabilities.get("pageAssets")).documentation()`.
>
> # API Reference
>
> Use this as the supported `agent.browsers.*` surface.
>
> ```ts
> // Returned by setupBrowserRuntime().
> // browser was selected during bootstrap.
> interface Agent {
>   browsers: Browsers; // API for finding and selecting browsers.
>   documentation: Documentation; // API for reading packaged browser-use documentation by name.
> }
>
> interface Browsers {
>   get(id: string): Promise<Browser>; // Get a browser by id or client type.
>   list(): Promise<Array<{ apiSupportOverrides?: Record<string, boolean>; capabilities: { browser?: Array<{ description: string; id: string }>; tab?: Array<{ description: string; id: string }> }; family?: string; id: string; metadata?: Record<string, string>; name: string; type: "iab" | "extension" | "cdp" }>>; // List available browsers.
> }
>
> interface Browser {
>   browserId: string; // Browser id selected by `agent.browsers.get()`.
>   capabilities: BrowserCapabilityCollection; // Browser-scoped optional capabilities advertised by the connected backend; discover IDs with `await browser.capabilities.list()`, then call `await (await browser.capabilities.get(id)).documentation()` for method details.
>   tabs: Tabs; // API for interacting with browser tabs.
>   user: BrowserUser; // Readonly context about the user's browser state.
>   documentation(): Promise<string>; // Read browser guidance and the core API reference.
>   nameSession(name: string): Promise<void>; // Name the current browser automation session.
> }
>
> interface BrowserUser {
>   claimTab(tab: string | BrowserUserTabInfo): Promise<Tab>; // Claim a user tab returned by `openTabs()` and return it as a controllable agent tab.
>   history(options: BrowserHistoryOptions): Promise<Array<BrowserHistoryEntry>>; // List recent browsing history ordered by `dateVisited` descending.
>   openTabs(): Promise<Array<BrowserUserTabInfo>>; // List open top-level tabs across the user's browser windows ordered by `lastOpened` descending.
> }
>
> interface Tabs {
>   finalize(options: FinalizeTabsOptions): Promise<void>; // Finalize the browser session's tabs by cleaning up tabs that are no longer needed.
>   get(id: string): Promise<Tab>; // Get a tab by id.
>   list(): Promise<Array<TabInfo>>; // List open tabs in the browser.
>   new(): Promise<Tab>; // Create and return a new tab in the browser.
>   selected(): Promise<undefined | Tab>; // Return the currently selected tab, if any.
> }
>
> interface Tab {
>   capabilities: TabCapabilityCollection; // Tab-scoped optional capabilities advertised by the connected backend; discover IDs with `await tab.capabilities.list()`, then call `await (await tab.capabilities.get(id)).documentation()` for method details.
>   clipboard: TabClipboardAPI; // API for interacting with the browser session's clipboard.
>   cua: CUAAPI; // API for interacting with the tab via the cua api
>   dev: TabDevAPI; // API for developer-oriented tab inspection.
>   dom_cua: DomCUAAPI; // API for interacting with the tab via the dom based cua api
>   id: string; // A tab's unique identifier
>   playwright: PlaywrightAPI; // API for interacting with the tab via the playwright api
>   back(): Promise<void>; // Navigate this tab back in history.
>   close(): Promise<void>; // Close this tab.
>   forward(): Promise<void>; // Navigate this tab forward in history.
>   getJsDialog(): Promise<undefined | Dialog>; // Get the active JavaScript dialog for this tab, if one is currently open.
>   goto(url: string): Promise<void>; // Open a URL in this tab.
>   reload(): Promise<void>; // Reload this tab.
>   screenshot(options: ScreenshotOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>; // Capture a screenshot of this tab.
>   title(): Promise<undefined | string>; // Get the current title for this tab.
>   url(): Promise<undefined | string>; // Get the current URL for this tab.
> }
>
> interface CUAAPI {
>   click(options: ClickOptions): Promise<void>; // Click at a coordinate in the current viewport.
>   double_click(options: DoubleClickOptions): Promise<void>; // Double click at a coordinate in the current viewport.
>   drag(options: DragOptions): Promise<void>; // Drag from a point to a point by the provided path.
>   keypress(options: KeypressOptions): Promise<void>; // Press control characters at the current focused element (focus it first via click/dblclick).
>   move(options: MoveOptions): Promise<void>; // Move the mouse to a point by the provided x and y coordinates.
>   scroll(options: ScrollOptions): Promise<void>; // Scroll by a delta from a specific viewport coordinate.
>   type(options: TypeOptions): Promise<void>; // Type text at the current focus.
> }
>
> interface DomCUAAPI {
>   click(options: DomClickOptions): Promise<void>; // Click a DOM node by its id from the visible DOM snapshot.
>   double_click(options: DomClickOptions): Promise<void>; // Double-click a DOM node by its id.
>   get_visible_dom(): Promise<unknown>; // Return a filtered DOM with node ids for interactable elements.
>   keypress(options: DomKeypressOptions): Promise<void>; // Press control characters at the currently focused element (focus it first via click/dblclick).
>   scroll(options: DomScrollOptions): Promise<void>; // Scroll either the page or a specific node (if node_id provided) by deltas.
>   type(options: DomTypeOptions): Promise<void>; // Type text into the currently focused element (focus via click first).
> }
>
> interface PlaywrightAPI {
>   domSnapshot(): Promise<string>; // Return a snapshot of the current DOM as a string, including expanded iframe body content when available.
>   evaluate<TResult, TArg>(pageFunction: PlaywrightEvaluateFunction<TArg, TResult>, arg?: TArg, options?: PlaywrightEvaluateOptions): Promise<TResult>; // Evaluate JavaScript in a read-only page scope.
>   expectNavigation<T>(action: () => Promise<T>, options: { timeoutMs?: number; url?: string; waitUntil?: LoadState }): Promise<T>; // Expect a navigation triggered by an action.
>   frameLocator(frameSelector: string): PlaywrightFrameLocator; // Create a frame-scoped locator builder.
>   getByLabel(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by label text within the page.
>   getByPlaceholder(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by placeholder text within the page.
>   getByRole(role: string, options: { exact?: boolean; name?: TextMatcher }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by ARIA role within the page.
>   getByTestId(testId: string): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by test id within the page.
>   getByText(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by text within the page.
>   locator(selector: string): PlaywrightLocator; // Create a locator scoped to this tab.
>   waitForEvent(event: "download", options?: WaitForEventOptions): Promise<PlaywrightDownload>; // Wait for the next event on the page.
>   waitForEvent(event: "filechooser", options?: WaitForEventOptions): Promise<PlaywrightFileChooser>;
>   waitForLoadState(options: PageWaitForLoadStateOptions): Promise<void>; // Wait for the page to reach a specific load state.
>   waitForTimeout(timeoutMs: number): Promise<void>; // Wait for a fixed duration.
>   waitForURL(url: string, options: PageWaitForURLOptions): Promise<void>; // Wait for the page URL to match the provided value.
> }
>
> interface PlaywrightFrameLocator {
>   frameLocator(frameSelector: string): PlaywrightFrameLocator; // Create a locator scoped to a nested frame.
>   getByLabel(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by label within this frame.
>   getByPlaceholder(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by placeholder within this frame.
>   getByRole(role: string, options: { exact?: boolean; name?: TextMatcher }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by ARIA role within this frame.
>   getByTestId(testId: string): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by test id within this frame.
>   getByText(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by text within this frame.
>   locator(selector: string): PlaywrightLocator; // Create a locator scoped to this frame.
> }
>
> interface PlaywrightLocator {
>   all(): Promise<Array<PlaywrightLocator>>; // Resolve to a list of locators for each matched element.
>   allTextContents(options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<Array<string>>; // Return `textContent` for *all* elements matched by this locator.
>   and(locator: PlaywrightLocator): PlaywrightLocator; // Return a locator matching elements that satisfy both this locator and `locator`.
>   check(options: LocatorCheckOptions): Promise<void>; // Check a checkbox or switch-like control.
>   click(options: LocatorClickOptions): Promise<void>; // Click the element matched by this locator.
>   count(): Promise<number>; // Number of elements matching this locator.
>   dblclick(options: LocatorClickOptions): Promise<void>; // Double-click the element matched by this locator.
>   downloadMedia(options: LocatorDownloadMediaOptions): Promise<void>; // Trigger a download for the media or file link in the first matched element.
>   evaluate<TResult, TArg>(pageFunction: LocatorEvaluateFunction<TArg, TResult>, arg?: TArg, options?: PlaywrightEvaluateOptions): Promise<TResult>; // Evaluate JavaScript in a read-only scope; the locator must resolve unambiguously to one element.
>   evaluateAll<TResult, TArg>(pageFunction: LocatorEvaluateAllFunction<TArg, TResult>, arg?: TArg, options?: PlaywrightEvaluateOptions): Promise<TResult>; // Evaluate read-only JavaScript against all elements matched by this locator.
>   fill(value: string, options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<void>; // Replace the element's value with the provided text.
>   filter(options: LocatorFilterOptions): PlaywrightLocator; // Narrow this locator by additional constraints.
>   first(): PlaywrightLocator; // Return a locator pointing at the first matched element.
>   getAttribute(name: string, options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<null | string>; // Return an attribute value from the first matched element.
>   getByLabel(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by label text, scoped to this locator.
>   getByPlaceholder(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by placeholder text, scoped to this locator.
>   getByRole(role: string, options: { exact?: boolean; name?: TextMatcher }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by ARIA role, scoped to this locator.
>   getByTestId(testId: string): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by test id, scoped to this locator.
>   getByText(text: TextMatcher, options: { exact?: boolean }): PlaywrightLocator; // Find elements by text content, scoped to this locator.
>   innerText(options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<string>; // Return the rendered (visible) text of the first matched element.
>   isEnabled(): Promise<boolean>; // Whether the first matched element is currently enabled.
>   isVisible(): Promise<boolean>; // Whether the first matched element is currently visible.
>   last(): PlaywrightLocator; // Return a locator pointing at the last matched element.
>   locator(selector: string, options: LocatorLocatorOptions): PlaywrightLocator; // Create a descendant locator scoped to this locator.
>   nth(index: number): PlaywrightLocator; // Return a locator pointing at the Nth matched element.
>   or(locator: PlaywrightLocator): PlaywrightLocator; // Return a locator matching elements that satisfy either this locator or `locator`.
>   press(value: string, options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<void>; // Press a keyboard key while this locator is focused.
>   selectOption(value: SelectOptionInput | Array<SelectOptionInput>, options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<void>; // Select one or more options on a native `<select>` element.
>   setChecked(checked: boolean, options: LocatorCheckOptions): Promise<void>; // Set a checkbox or switch-like control to a checked/unchecked state.
>   textContent(options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<null | string>; // Return the raw textContent of the first matched element (or null if missing).
>   type(value: string, options: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<void>; // Type text into the element without clearing existing content.
>   uncheck(options: LocatorCheckOptions): Promise<void>; // Uncheck a checkbox or switch-like control.

前端已在应用内浏览器打开：

[http://127.0.0.1:5173/overview](http://127.0.0.1:5173/overview)

后端和前端服务都保持运行中，目前页面显示真实检测产生的 4 个风险发现。

> 那我怎么实现所谓TB级呢

“TB 级”不是让模型一次把 1 TB 日志装进内存，而是做到：

> 日志分块流入、分区存储、并行计算、增量维护状态，最终只把少量风险结果交给模型和前端。

你们当前项目还不是 TB 级，主要阻塞点很明确：

- `list(load_jsonl(...))` 会把全部日志载入内存。
- 模板频率、实体频率都保存在单进程 `Counter`。
- `logs.jsonl`、`windows.json` 是单文件输出。
- API 会一次读取完整 JSON。
- 攻击链状态没有分布式持久化和过期机制。

## 最短可落地方案

时间有限，我建议做“离线 TB 扫描＋准实时增量检测”，暂时不要上复杂的全实时模型训练。

```text
原始日志
  ↓
Kafka / 文件批量导入
  ↓
Spark / Flink 分布式解析与标准化
  ↓
Parquet + MinIO/S3 分区存储
  ↓
分区内异常检测
  ↓
实体/时间窗口关联
  ↓
ClickHouse 风险结果库
  ↓
FastAPI + 前端
```

建议技术选择：

| 环节 | 推荐实现 |
|---|---|
| 日志接入 | Kafka；比赛演示可先支持目录/对象存储批量导入 |
| 原始存储 | MinIO/S3＋Parquet |
| 批处理 | PySpark |
| 流处理 | Flink；时间不足可暂时只做 Spark Structured Streaming |
| 状态存储 | RocksDB/Flink State，或 Redis |
| 风险结果查询 | ClickHouse |
| 模型推理 | 每个分区批量推理，必要时 ONNX Runtime |
| 前端 API | FastAPI 只查询 ClickHouse 聚合结果 |

## 第一项改造：全链路流式处理

把：

```python
events = list(load_jsonl(input_path))
```

改成批处理迭代器：

```python
for batch in iter_jsonl_batches(input_path, batch_size=100_000):
    parsed = parse_batch(batch)
    scores = detector.score_batch(parsed)
    write_partition(scores)
```

单批内存固定，不随总数据量增加。

更进一步，用 Spark：

```python
logs = (
    spark.readStream
    .schema(log_schema)
    .json(input_path)
)

features = (
    logs
    .withColumn("date", to_date("timestamp"))
    .repartition("date", "source_type")
)

result = detect_partition(features)
```

核心指标不是“总共多少条”，而是：

- 峰值内存是否随数据量保持稳定；
- 增加计算节点后吞吐是否近似线性增长；
- 失败后能否从 checkpoint 恢复。

## 第二项改造：分区数据湖

不要再生成一个巨大的 `logs.jsonl`，改为：

```text
data_lake/
  raw/
    date=2026-08-09/
      source_type=ETW/
        part-00001.parquet
      source_type=DNS/
        part-00001.parquet

  normalized/
    date=2026-08-09/
      hour=02/
        part-00001.parquet

  findings/
    severity=critical/
      date=2026-08-09/
```

推荐分区字段：

- `tenant_id`
- `event_date`
- `hour`
- `source_type`

每个 Parquet 文件控制在约 128–512 MB，避免海量小文件。

保留这些溯源字段：

```text
dataset_id
source_object
source_partition
source_offset
source_line
raw_sha256
parser_version
model_version
```

这样风险结果仍然能够追溯到原日志。

## 第三项改造：增量无监督基线

当前实现会扫描全部事件建立 `Counter`。TB 级需要增量状态。

### 模板频率

使用滑动时间窗或近似计数：

```text
key = tenant_id + source_type + template_id
value = count_1h / count_24h / count_7d
```

可使用：

- Count-Min Sketch：近似模板频率；
- HyperLogLog：实体去重计数；
- TDigest：日志长度、请求大小等分位数；
- EWMA：行为均值与漂移；
- Welford 算法：在线均值和方差。

这些状态都不需要保存每一条历史日志。

### 实体基线

```text
entity_id →
  常见主机集合
  常见进程集合
  活跃小时分布
  来源类型分布
  网络目标分布
  最近出现时间
```

增加：

- TTL，例如保留30天；
- 最大实体数；
- LRU 淘汰；
- 状态 checkpoint；
- 冷状态存放到 ClickHouse/Redis。

## 第四项改造：分布式攻击链聚合

按照稳定实体进行分区：

```text
keyBy(tenant_id, entity_id)
  → 30分钟微窗口
  → 24小时长时窗口
  → 风险窗口
  → 攻击链
```

强锚点：

- 用户账号；
- 主机；
- 设备 ID；
- 进程树 ID；
- 文件 Hash。

弱锚点：

- 共享 IP；
- NAT 地址；
- 常见域名。

不要仅凭共享 IP 拼接攻击链。

为了处理乱序日志，需要：

- Event Time；
- Watermark；
- 最大允许迟到时间；
- 重复事件去重；
- 状态 TTL。

## 第五项改造：模型只处理候选事件

不能让复杂模型处理全部日志。

推荐三级漏斗：

```text
100% 原始日志
    ↓ 解析、模板统计、简单规则
约 1% 稀有候选
    ↓ 无监督异常检测
约 0.1% 高异常事件
    ↓ 语义模型、图模型、攻击链关联
约 0.01% 风险发现
    ↓ 前端和 Agent
```

例如：

```text
10 亿条日志
→ 1,000 万条稀有候选
→ 100 万条异常事件
→ 1 万条风险窗口
→ 数百个调查案件
```

这样 M1–M6 不需要直接吞吐全部 TB 日志。

## TB 级到底需要多少吞吐

假设每条日志平均 1 KB：

- 1 TB/天约为 11,600 EPS；
- 10 TB/天约为 116,000 EPS；
- 1 TB/小时约为 278 MB/s。

因此答辩时应明确目标：

> 系统目标为持续处理 1 TB/天，而不是在几分钟内处理完 1 TB。

这两种说法的工程难度完全不同。

## 如何证明，而不是口头宣称

至少执行四档测试：

| 规模 | 目的 |
|---:|---|
| 1 GB | 功能正确性 |
| 10 GB | 单机基准 |
| 100 GB | 稳态内存和恢复能力 |
| 1 TB | 分布式扩展验证 |

报告应包含：

- 总日志量及记录数；
- 平均和 P95 EPS；
- 端到端 P50/P95 延迟；
- 峰值内存；
- CPU/GPU 利用率；
- checkpoint 恢复时间；
- 重复率、丢失率；
- 计算节点数；
- 每个阶段的输入输出数量；
- 数据集生成方式和 SHA256。

还要做横向扩展实验：

| Worker | EPS | 加速比 |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 15k | 1.0× |
| 2 | 28k | 1.87× |
| 4 | 52k | 3.47× |

## 时间有限时的现实路线

建议按这个顺序做：

1. 将现有检测器改造成固定批次、常数内存。
2. 输出改为分区 Parquet。
3. 增加 PySpark 运行入口。
4. 攻击链候选写入 ClickHouse。
5. API 改为分页查询 ClickHouse。
6. 生成 100 GB 合成背景日志并实测。
7. 有集群条件时扩到 1 TB。

如果暂时没有足够机器，答辩要准确表述：

> 已完成面向 TB 级的数据分区与流式架构，单机实测 100 GB；1 TB 为基于相同分区任务的集群扩展目标。

不要在没跑过 1 TB 时写“已经通过 TB 级验证”。评委通常会追问机器配置、耗时、峰值内存和失败恢复，一问就能判断真实性。
